summary.text: April N.M. Baskin is a Democratic state senator from New York who has represented District 63 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served on the Erie County Legislature from 2018 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: April Baskin was born in Buffalo, New York, received a high school diploma from Buffalo Public Schools, and earned a bachelor's degree from Empire State College.
Ballotpedia describes her career experience as public service.
Baskin represented District 2 on the Erie County Legislature from 2018 to 2025, then assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2025, succeeding Timothy M. Kennedy.

Her Senate committee assignments, per Ballotpedia, include chair of the Procurement and Contracts Committee and membership on the Cultural Affairs, Tourism, Parks and Recreation; Commerce, Economic Development and Small Business; and Veterans, Homeland Security and Military Affairs committees.
In the 2026 general election she faces Geoffrey Szymanski, who is running on the Republican and Conservative Party lines.
